purpose: Shared interpretation constraints for using path knowledge alongside system-level logs; not event instances or detections.

principles.statement: A registry key is a named container; a value has its own name, type and data. Keep the event key path and value name separate. Do not automatically turn a terminal value name into another key node.
Security event 4656 reports a requested object handle and the access-request outcome. It does not establish that the requested operation was performed.
Registry auditing depends on audit policy and matching object SACL entries. Missing events are not proof of absent access. Sysmon filtering also limits what is collected.

WOW64 gives selected registry areas separate logical views and shares others. Preserve explicit Wow6432Node components and architecture/view metadata; do not collapse all views or assume every Software key is redirected.

Kernel-mode Registry paths use the native namespace: \Registry\Machine corresponds to HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE and \Registry\User corresponds to HKEY_USERS. HKEY_CURRENT_USER has no simple kernel-mode equivalent, so adapters must retain an observed user SID rather than silently converting it to HKCU.

A documented configuration role identifies what a target is for. A separate log record is needed to establish what happened; effective behavior may additionally depend on values, precedence, platform support and consumers.

providers.meaning: Registry object creation or deletion; inspect event subtype to distinguish the operation and object kind.
Registry value modification. The documentation specifies captured written data for DWORD and QWORD types; do not assume every data type is completely represented.
Registry key or value rename, including its new name. A rename is not a value-setting operation.

An audited registry value was modified; the event distinguishes the key ObjectName from ObjectValueName and includes operation and old/new value fields. It is not a general record of key modifications.
An object handle was requested. Check object type, requested rights and audit outcome; handle access does not prove execution of a later operation.

integration_contract.key_path: Pass the key path separately to KnowledgeBase.model_context. Use path_format=nt_native only for documented \Registry\Machine and \Registry\User roots; the adapter preserves the raw input and SID. Enable template_candidates explicitly for constrained pattern retrieval.
integration_contract.value_name: Pass separately when the provider identifies a value. This repository does not guess the key/value boundary from an ambiguous compound target string.
integration_contract.unmatched_suffix: Retain unknown concrete names. Optional template matching is typed and reports pattern_complete separately from exact path_complete; it supplies candidate schema knowledge, not evidence that a concrete key exists.
integration_contract.event_metadata: Keep provider/version, operation, result, timestamp, actor/process, raw target, registry view and value data alongside the knowledge response, not as new knowledge nodes.
integration_contract.label_policy: No malicious/benign, ATT&CK or automatic legacy-rule labels are inferred from path knowledge.
